notes:
Summary: ConversioSphere is a CX platform vendor with global telco customers; building a managed contact-center product that embeds assistant + automations. Primary ask = robust multilingual agent-assist + ticket summarization with locale-aware tone (EN/FR/ES/PT/DE) and deterministic tool-calling for back-end systems. Key constraints: must run in customer VPC or Redwood Private, SOC2 + SSO, KMS/HSM for keys, and EU data residency for several accounts. They are cost-aware but prioritize reliability during B2B onboard spikes.

Recent call highlights: - "Too many false-positives on suggested macros" — product lead. Wants quality guardrails / evaluation sets per locale. - Security: "we cannot have keys leave our cloud" — infra lead. Needs HSM diagram and audit log retention SLA. - Ops: concerned about autoscaling cold-start latency for spikes from campaign launches.

POC goals (customer): 1) Achieve <=120ms median token latency for EN/FR under 50 RPS, 2) Summaries within 2s for 90% of tickets, 3) Correctly route 95% of language-detected sessions to regional model variants, 4) Demonstrate fallback to lower-cost variants with graceful degradation.
